data.title: 伽玛 · 睡裙与庆功酒
data.description: 商会季度利润翻番的夜里，伽玛破例给自己斟了一杯酒。靛蓝丝绸睡裙贴着她成熟的身段，吊带在举杯时滑下臂弯。她望着窗外的王都灯火，小声说了一句——「暗影大人，这份江山，又大了一圈。」
data.action: 倚着阳台栏杆举杯，睡裙吊带滑落，望着夜景微笑
data.lighting: moonlight and warm balcony lantern light
data.promptProse: On her private balcony, adult Gamma raises a glass in a silk indigo nightgown, one strap fallen, smiling at the capital's lights her company now owns a piece of.
data.animaCaption: One glass for a doubled quarter. Gamma toasts the night city — and the man who gave her every idea in it.
